text: The calculus of constructions (CoC, Coquand-Huet 1988) extends MLTT by:
choices: combining System F (polymorphism) with dependent types in a single framework
explanation: CoC: the top of the Barendregt cube. It has ∀α:* and Π(x:A).B — full dependent types plus polymorphism. The kernel of Coq is based on CIC (Calculus of Inductive Constructions), an extension of CoC.
